Monthly Victorian public transport patronage by mode

Source: R/data.R
monthly_patronage.Rd

Monthly patronage (patron boardings) for metropolitan train, tram and bus, and V/Line (regional) train, coach and bus services in Victoria, Australia, from January 2018 onwards.

Usage

monthly_patronage

Format

A data frame with one row per mode per month, and columns:

date

Date of the first day of the reporting month.

year

Calendar year.

month

Month number (1-12).

month_name

Month name.

mode

Transport mode: Metropolitan train, Metropolitan tram, Metropolitan bus, Regional train, Regional coach, or Regional bus.

patronage

Count of patron boardings for that mode and month.

fare_period

Factor flagging months substantially affected by a Victorian Government fare discount: "Normal fares", "Weekend free travel" (Dec 2025-Jan 2026, weekends only), "Free travel (every day)" (Apr-May 2026) or "Half-price fares" (from Jun 2026). Patronage during non-"Normal fares" months is expected to be inflated by the discount itself and should not be read as organic recovery or demand growth; see Details.

Source

Victorian Department of Transport and Planning, Open Data portal, "Monthly public transport patronage by mode", https://opendata.transport.vic.gov.au/dataset/monthly-public-transport-patronage-by-mode, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.

Details

One data quality issue was corrected during preparation: the raw "Regional bus" figure for November 2024 was exported as the string "940930Jan-25" rather than a plain number. The leading digits were extracted as the true value; see data-raw/monthly_patronage.R for the full justification and cleaning code.

fare_period draws on two source tiers. Free WEEKEND travel only (30 Nov 2025-1 Feb 2026) and a single free weekday (31 Mar 2026) are documented in the source dataset's own "Data Quality" notes; Dec 2025 and Jan 2026 are flagged "Weekend free travel", while Feb and Mar 2026 are left as "Normal fares" since only a single day of each month was affected. The subsequent extension to genuinely continuous (every-day) free travel through April-May 2026, and half-price fares from 1 June 2026, are not mentioned in the dataset's documentation (as at the time this package's data was last refreshed) and are instead sourced from official Victorian Government media releases: the Premier's "Extra Month Of Free PT - Then Half-Price Fares For All" (19 Apr 2026) and Transport Victoria's "Public transport now half price for everyone" (22 May 2026). See data-raw/monthly_patronage.R for full source URLs.
